library(rprojroot)
projroot <- find_root(is_rstudio_project)
gitroot <- find_root(is_git_root)
datapath <- file.path(projroot, "data")
for (subdir in c(
  "binary/results",
  "text/raw"
)) {
  path <- file.path(datapath, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE)
}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)

source(file.path(projroot, "R/functions.R"))
opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  dpi = 300,
  fig.align = "center"
)
our_kbl <- function(df) {
  df %>% 
    kbl(table.attr = 'data-quarto-disable-processing="true"') %>% 
    kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, bootstrap_options = "striped")
}
our_scroll_kbl <- function(df, width = NULL, height = NULL) {
  our_kbl(df) %>% 
    scroll_box(width = width, height = height)
}
